verdict: Leads are up sharply this week; key setup milestones remain overdue.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 43 leads from Meta at a cost of $6.61 per lead, and the most recent week saw leads jump 87% over the week prior — a strong short-term signal. That momentum is running on Meta alone, however, because nine planned setup milestones — including landing pages, conversion tracking, search campaigns, and CRM migration — remain undelivered, some by as much as 51 days. As a direct result, your website logged zero tracked conversions across 3,452 sessions this period; conversion tracking is being completed as a priority item so this gap closes before it compounds. Clearing the remaining milestones is the focus between now and the Phase 1 close on September 30, after which the full channel mix — search, local service ads, and nurture sequences — will be in place to support and sustain the lead volume you're already seeing from Meta.
